title: Draft for 2026-10-12 to 2026-10-18
summary: Listed automatically from official feeds. Not reviewed. Each item quotes its source; check it before it moves into a published digest.

items.title: Client telemetry user attribution and configurable capture
items.text: Enterprise administrators can now use telemetry in managed settings to attribute GitHub Copilot activity to a user without collecting their prompts, responses, or tool content.
candidateLines: Enterprise administrators can now use telemetry in managed settings to attribute GitHub Copilot activity to a user without collecting their prompts, responses, or tool content.

items.title: HydraFusion updates and new Max option
items.text: HydraFusion has an updated model pool, improved orchestration workflows, and introduces HydraFusion Max.
candidateLines: HydraFusion has an updated model pool, improved orchestration workflows, and introduces HydraFusion Max.

items.title: Multi-repository support and other improvements for GitHub in Slack and Teams
items.text: @GitHub in Slack and Teams now supports working across multiple repositories in a single conversation.
candidateLines: @GitHub in Slack and Teams now supports working across multiple repositories in a single conversation.

items.title: Claude Code v2.1.302
items.text: Added CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_MODEL to choose the model the client-side auto mode classifier uses; it does not change the model for server-side auto mode
candidateLines: Added CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_MODEL to choose the model the client-side auto mode classifier uses; it does not change the model for server-side auto mode
Added an Idle compaction row to /config for turning idle compaction off or back on; the notices shown after an idle compaction now say how to turn it off
Added a notice to /design-sync and /design-login that standalone Claude Design (claude.ai/design) closes by December 14, 2026

items.title: Cloud Agent Canvases and Environment Improvements
items.text: Cloud agents can now build and share interactive canvases.
candidateLines: Cloud agents can now build and share interactive canvases.
